import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

# Parse the arXiv API response
result_data = json.loads(_last_tool_result)
content = result_data.get('content', '')

# Parse XML response
root = ET.fromstring(content)

# Define namespace
ns = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}

papers = []
for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', ns):
    paper = {}
    paper['id'] = entry.find('atom:id', ns).text
    paper['title'] = entry.find('atom:title', ns).text.strip()
    paper['summary'] = entry.find('atom:summary', ns).text.strip()
    paper['published'] = entry.find('atom:published', ns).text
    paper['updated'] = entry.find('atom:updated', ns).text
    
    # Get authors
    authors = []
    for author in entry.findall('atom:author', ns):
        name = author.find('atom:name', ns).text
        authors.append(name)
    paper['authors'] = authors
    
    # Get categories
    categories = []
    for cat in entry.findall('atom:category', ns):
        categories.append(cat.get('term'))
    paper['categories'] = categories
    
    # Get links
    links = {}
    for link in entry.findall('atom:link', ns):
        rel = link.get('rel')
        href = link.get('href')
        if rel == 'alternate':
            links['html'] = href
        elif rel == 'related' and link.get('title') == 'pdf':
            links['pdf'] = href
    paper['links'] = links
    
    papers.append(paper)

print(f"Found {len(papers)} papers")
for i, p in enumerate(papers):
    print(f"\n--- Paper {i+1} ---")
    print(f"Title: {p['title']}")
    print(f"Authors: {', '.join(p['authors'])}")
    print(f"Published: {p['published']}")
    print(f"Categories: {p['categories']}")
    print(f"Summary: {p['summary'][:300]}...")
    print(f"Links: {p['links']}")

# Store papers for next step
import pickle
with open('/tmp/papers.pkl', 'wb') as f:
    pickle.dump(papers, f)
